veranderings.voor: Net soos jy het elke kind by die eerste boere
veranderings.na: Net soos jy, het elke kind van die eerste boere
veranderings.rede: Without the comma 'Net soos jy het' first reads as 'just as you have', and the double 'by ... by' is clumsy.
'saamwoon' is a separable compound verb, so its past participle is written as one word.
Afrikaans says someone stands 'bo' others in rank; 'oor ... gestaan' is not idiomatic.
The relative refers to the land itself, so 'waarop' is more precise than 'waar'.
'kos verbou' is the natural Afrikaans collocation; 'kos kweek' is wooden.

veranderings.voor: wat ongelukkig was met hulle leier
veranderings.na: wat met hulle leier ongelukkig was
veranderings.rede: In a written relative clause the finite verb goes to the end.
Standard written Afrikaans uses 'ophou om te' with an infinitive here.

veranderings.voor: opperhoofskap, wat besluite vir sy mense geneem het
veranderings.na: opperhoofskap, wat besluite vir sy mense neem
veranderings.rede: The definition opens in the present ('Die leier van') and the other definitions are timeless, so the past tense clause clashes.

veranderings.voor: By latere boere 'n leier van 'n kleiner gebied onder 'n opperhoof.
veranderings.na: By latere boere was dit 'n leier van 'n kleiner gebied onder 'n opperhoof.
veranderings.rede: The definition is a fragment that starts with a prepositional phrase and has no verb, which reads awkwardly when looked up alone.
